Image generation request routed through the proxy

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.createImageRequestFromJson("{\"model\":\"dall-e-3\",\"n\":1,\"prompt\":\"A sunset over the ocean\",\"size\":\"1024x1024\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.imageGenerate(_req)
debugPrint(result.data)
debugPrint(result.data[0].url as Any)
```
